<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> Indian indices erased early gains to close significantly lower, driven by sustained FII selling, a spike in crude oil prices, and rising domestic bond yields.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>

  <li><strong>Bond Market Stress:</strong> The 10-year bond yield hit a three-year high of 7.40% following RBI liquidity tightening measures, which also triggered a sharp decline in Bank Nifty.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic Squeeze:</strong> Global volatility, characterized by elevated crude oil prices and high US bond yields, continues to weigh on Indian equities and capital flows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W27</a></span></li>
